introText: A description of the focus for Q2 2026, including a summary of the key areas of development and strategic initiatives.

items.title: Relative date range filtering
items.why: Supports common time-based filtering tasks that users expect from spreadsheet and BI tools.
items.desc: Filter dates using built-in ranges like Today, This Week, Last Quarter, and Year to Date, without writing custom comparator logic.

items.title: Formula editor
items.why: Brings familiar spreadsheet workflows directly into calculation-heavy grid applications.
items.desc: Enter spreadsheet-style formulas into grid cells, with cell references, functions, and an autocomplete-enabled editor.

items.title: Editing of Aggregated Values
items.why: Supports top-down editing workflows common in budgeting and planning applications.
items.desc: Edit a group or total row's aggregated value directly, automatically distributing the change across its children.

items.title: Keep Row Group State and Compact Mode
items.why: Maintains user context after data refreshes while keeping multi-level grouping views uncluttered.
items.desc: Preserve expanded row groups across grid updates, and hide group columns for levels that haven't been expanded yet.

items.title: Deferred updates to Columns Tool Panel
items.why: Avoids unnecessary recomputation and server requests when making several changes at once.
items.desc: Stage multiple column, group, and pivot changes in the Columns Tool Panel and commit them together with an Apply action.

items.title: Quick Access Toolbar
items.why: Gives users faster access to common grid actions without opening a menu or side bar.
items.desc: A configurable toolbar above the grid for quick filter, find, export menus, and custom actions.

items.title: Grand Total Row for Server-side Row Model
items.why: Extends grand total reporting to large, server-backed datasets that can't be loaded entirely client-side.
items.desc: Display an always-visible grand total row across the full server-side dataset, supplied and updated by the server.

items.title: Adding Notes to Grid Cells
items.why: Supports collaborative review and annotation workflows directly inside the grid.
items.desc: Attach comments to individual cells, viewable on hover or click, without storing note text in row data.

items.title: Add Calculated Columns
items.why: Enables ad-hoc analysis without requiring changes to the underlying data or application code.
items.desc: Let users add new read-only columns computed from other columns using expressions, directly from the column menu.

items.title: Automatic Column Generation
items.why: Brings zero-configuration setup to grids with dynamic or unknown schemas.
items.desc: Enable automatic column definition generation from row data.

items.title: Improved Option Validation
items.why: Reduces setup mistakes and speeds up debugging during development.
items.desc: Clearer, more detailed warnings when grid options or column definitions are misconfigured.

items.title: Aggregated Value Transformations
items.why: Supports relative comparisons alongside absolute totals in grouped and pivoted views.
items.desc: Display an aggregated value as a percentage of its grand, column, row, or parent group total.

items.title: Markdown versions of documentation
items.why: Makes docs easier for AI coding assistants and LLM-based tools to consume accurately.
items.desc: Publish documentation pages in Markdown alongside the standard HTML format.

items.title: Column Header Editing
items.why: Supports spreadsheet-like customisation for end users managing their own views.
items.desc: Let users rename a column's header text directly in the grid, without changing the column definition in code.

items.title: Custom context menu in Columns Tool Panel
items.why: Gives developers the same control over this menu as they already have over the grid's main context menu.
items.desc: Customise the items shown in the Columns Tool Panel's right-click context menu.

items.title: Set Filter Support in Advanced Filtering
items.why: Simplifies building complex filters that would otherwise need many chained OR conditions.
items.desc: Reference Set Filter-style multi-value lists as a single condition inside Advanced Filter expressions.

items.title: AI Coding Skill
items.why: Keeps AI-generated grid code aligned with current APIs instead of outdated training data.
items.desc: An installable skill package that gives AI coding assistants up-to-date, official guidance for building AG Grid applications.

items.title: PDF Export
items.why: Supports sharing and printing grid data in a fixed, presentation-ready format.
items.desc: Export grid data directly to PDF, alongside the existing CSV and Excel export options.

items.title: Continuous Column Auto-sizing
items.why: Keeps column widths accurate in grids with changing or incrementally loaded data.
items.desc: Keep columns auto-sized as data updates and new rows scroll into view, rather than sizing once.

items.title: Multiple Aggregations per Column
items.why: Supports richer summary views without duplicating columns for each aggregation function.
items.desc: Show more than one aggregation result, such as sum and average, for the same value column at once.

items.title: Persistent Set Filter Selections
items.why: Prevents rows from silently disappearing after data updates change the available filter values.
items.desc: Keep a user's Set Filter selections intact when new distinct values appear in the data.

items.title: Accessibility for Tooltips
items.why: Closes a known accessibility gap so tooltip content is available to assistive technology users.
items.desc: Add tooltips on built-in buttons across the grid UI.
